goal_checks.notes: Manual Work offline is a durable slice field and sets the phase directly; the browser's online handler now only dispatches networkDownSet(false) and never sets collaboration, so a reconnect cannot resync without the banner's button (spec §5.3). A persisted manual choice outranks navigator.onLine on workspace open. sync-slice.test.ts pins degrade-only auto-detect and persistence; sync-listener.test.ts still proves a phase change runs push -> pull -> resubscribe.

OfflineBanner shows the queue and lastSyncedAt; DisabledWhenOffline renders a control disabled with title + aria-disabled and a reason, never hidden. offline-banner.test.tsx pins both. The goal's literal 'group sheet read-only' is task 013's sheet (013 is blocked on 012), so the sheet application is deferred to 013; g2 is passed on its acceptance criterion ('every disabled control explains why'), and the deferral is recorded in issues_found.

The banner's label is 'Back online · N changes to sync' where N is selectPendingCount (the outbox count dispatched by 007's watcher), and the only control that moves the phase back to collaboration is the 'Sync now' button (manualOfflineSet(false)). offline-banner.test.tsx asserts the label, the N, and the presence/absence of the button.

shared/lib/bundle.ts loads the original bytes and appends one /Highlight per rect with /NM = the slug (pdf-lib), never re-rendering a page; renderNotesMarkdown emits the <!-- tb … --> anchors; buildManifest emits thinkboard.json; buildBundleZip zips all three with fflate. bundle.test.ts re-reads the saved PDF and asserts the annotation, its /NM, the QuadPoints Y-flip, and that the original bytes stay annotation-free; it also round-trips the zip.

parseNotesMarkdown treats only the `<!-- tb id=… -->` comment as an identity anchor (RULE-25). planReimport matches known slugs into `updates` (no duplicate), routes an anchorless section to `unanchored`, and reports both an unknown slug (`orphans`) and a known slug absent from the file (`missing`) rather than guessing or dropping. bundle.test.ts proves export -> edit prose -> re-import yields exactly the two matched updates and zero unanchored/orphan/missing.

clearProfileArtifacts removes the profile's own OPFS directory (never another profile's), and useSignOut now calls it before deleteDb; the outbox guard still refuses while a write is unsynced. D-10 is encoded as isCacheableOffline(slot) = slot === 'main', so the group (note-slot) document is not cached offline by default. opfs.test.ts and use-sign-out.test.tsx pin all of it.

issues_found: g2's group-sheet read-only behaviour is task 013's (013 is blocked on 012). 016 delivers the offline banner (with lastSyncedAt) and the DisabledWhenOffline wrapper and passes g2 on its acceptance criterion; applying the wrapper to the sheet stays 013's. Raised, not silently substituted.

No UI trigger for export/re-import yet: bundle.ts is the complete, tested seam, but assembling a whole session's rows needs a session-wide read (a new queries/use-*-for-session member) and there is still no document-view route. Same route-wiring gap 009/010/011/012 recorded; left as a follow-up.

Spec §5.6 says 'append' annotations; pdf-lib rewrites the object graph rather than byte-concatenating. It does not re-render any page, so the text layer is preserved (the actual prohibition), but this is not a literal incremental byte append — flagged in case a byte-exact append is later required.
007's auto-resync on the browser `online` event is intentionally replaced by the explicit button (spec §5.3). 007's phase-change tests still pass, but this is a behaviour change to record.
The bundle has no ink/{slug}.svg: handwritten-note export is only meaningful once ink input exists (024); the format reserves the path.

The airplane-mode browser pass on a live stack (the plan's Gate) is deferred as a follow-up, as with 009/011's hardware gates; the offline behaviour is proven by unit tests with the outbox slice, not a real network cut.
